curated.tagline: AI-powered interactive projection system with computer vision and gesture recognition
curated.description: AI-powered interactive projection system using computer vision, gesture recognition, and real-time AI to transform any surface into a responsive knowledge canvas. Features MediaPipe-based hand/face/pose tracking, WebGL 3D scene rendering, and a multi-service architecture with Express backend, Vite React frontend, and Python vision pipeline.
highlights: Modern React patterns and responsive UI
